# Lifecycle email that stops when the customer converts.

> A free, open-source alternative to Customer.io, Loops and Userlist: your app posts events, sequences send onboarding, trial and win-back email, and a goal event stops the rest. Preview exactly what a person would receive and when, in your browser, then run the server in your own account.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
